bull.b: Topline results from the pivotal double‑blind ALS study could support a regulatory submission and materially change company valuation if efficacy is confirmed.
An existing approval in other countries and a well‑characterized safety profile reduce regulatory risk and strengthen the pathway to approval for the ALS indication.
The SEANOBI expanded‑access program provides real‑world safety, clinical, and biomarker data that can complement randomized trial findings and bolster confidence in observed efficacy signals.

bear.b: Phase 2 testing of the metabolic candidate missed primary endpoints and tipelukast failed key co‑primary measures, creating uncertainty that could limit future development or commercial prospects.
